@zachleat I would actually de-prioritize Watchmen. Not because it isn't good but because the context of comic reading is a large part of the story. For example, there is a reason why the panel layout never changes until the very end. If you read it after having consumed more comics, you'll grok it more.

The Matt Fraction/David Aja Hawkeye run from 10 or 15 years ago is fun and a lot lighter read than your list. The Disney+ show was influenced a lot by that run.

Your list is good but also some pretty heavy reading. If you care at all about Transformers, my kid loved the recent Image Comics series and those are pretty easy to come by in collections.

I probably have enough recommendations now to last me for a few years 😅 — thank you everyone!

Compiled a lot of them here, if folks are interested: https://leagueofcomicgeeks.com/profile/zachleat/wish-list

@zachleat FWIW, both Marvel and DC have subscription services that give you access to nearly everything in their back catalog. If I were in your shoes, I'd pick one of them, prioritize books from that publisher and then pick off some indies in addition that you either buy or check out from the library. Then next year, maybe switch to the other publisher and do the same.

Given Watchmen and Dark Knight Returns are seminal, I'd probably start with the DC sub.

@zachleat Oh, and DC Universe Infinite Ultra (higher tier) includes Vertigo which adds books like Daytripper, Y The Last Man, Preacher, and Fables. More good books than you'll have time for in a year.
